analyst.summary: Dilip Buildcon is a large roads and infrastructure EPC contractor that is trying to diversify into mining services and long-term infrastructure asset ownership to build steadier, more annuity-like revenue. The order book is at an all-time high, giving good revenue visibility, but quarterly profit fell sharply in the most recent quarter, and the company carries meaningful consolidated debt along with a partly pledged promoter shareholding -- a combination that argues for caution until the newer, steadier businesses are large enough to show through in the numbers.
